from build123d import *

# ---- Dimensions (mm) ----
outer_radius_main = 19.2      # Ø38.4
outer_radius_collar = 22.65   # Ø45.3
body_length = 80.0
collar_length = 21.3
body_section_length = body_length - collar_length   # 58.7
bore_radius = 12.0            # Ø24
chamfer_distance = 4.0        # collar tip chamfer

# ---- Build ----
with BuildPart() as p:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.XY) as sk:
        with BuildLine() as bl:
            Polyline(
                (0, 0),
                (0, outer_radius_main),
                (body_section_length, outer_radius_main),
                (body_section_length, outer_radius_collar),
                (body_length, outer_radius_collar),
                (body_length, 0),
                close=True,
            )
        make_face()
    revolve(axis=Axis.X)

solid_body = p.part
solid_body = solid_body - Rot(0, 90, 0) * Cylinder(bore_radius, body_length)

# Chamfer on the outer rim of the collar (edges on the >X face)
tip_face = solid_body.faces().sort_by(Axis.X)[-1]
solid_body = chamfer(tip_face.edges(), chamfer_distance)

part = solid_body
part.name = "revolved_shaft_with_collar"
export_step(part, "output.step")

boss3_x = 65.3

hole3_d = 12.8

gusset_height = 36.6
gusset_thickness = 4.0

# ---- Base plate ----
base = Box(base_width, base_depth, base_height)

# ---- Triangular gusset on back face ----
with BuildPart() as gp:
    with BuildSketch(Plane.YZ.offset(-base_depth / 2)) as gs:
        with BuildLine() as gl:
            Polyline((0, -base_height / 2), (gusset_thickness, -base_height / 2), (gusset_thickness, 0), close=True)
        make_face()
    extrude(amount=-gusset_thickness)
gusset = gp.part

# ---- Bosses (cylinders along Y) ----
boss1 = Pos(boss1_x - base_width / 2, base_depth / 2 + boss_length / 2, boss_z - base_height / 2) * Rot(90, 0, 0) * Cylinder(boss_radius, boss_length)
